answer: Shared-fate bonds: every agent locks a 500-token bond in a vault, and the network clusters identities whose timing, funding source and phrasing correlate too closely. A flagged cluster loses all its bonds at once, so a sable swarm of 200 puppets risks 100,000 tokens on a single detection, while an honest agent pays only idle capital. Clean identities reach safe harbor after a year and reclaim the bond, making long-run honesty cheap and mass faking one ruinous bet.
